lines: Q: What's the hardest part of meals for you? Or something else.
A: Cooking separately for my parents' health every day. Amma is diabetic, Nanna needs soft food and less salt.

Q: Which apps do you order groceries on: Zepto, Blinkit, Instamart, BigBasket or Amazon? If you sign me in, I'll read your past orders to learn what your home buys and how often, so the plan and the shopping list fit you from the first week, and I can fill the cart for you. Nothing is ordered without your yes.
A: BigBasket only. And later on the sign in, let's just get the plan sorted first.
Q: Which is your main app, and which do you use when something isn't there?
A: BigBasket only, told you already. If something's not there I just skip or find an alternative on BigBasket itself.
Q: I have Srinivas (45), Padma (42), Karan (15), Sarojini (70) and Venkat (74) eating at home. Anyone else who eats at home, or anyone who doesn't?
A: Right, just the five of us. No one else eats here regularly.
Q: Kavitha cooks Mon-Sat: Breakfast and Lunch at 7:30am, Dinner at 6:30pm. Is that right, and does the cook come for any other meals?
A: That's right, Kavitha comes for breakfast and lunch at 7:30 morning, and dinner at 6:30 evening. No other meals.
Q: Is the cook short of time, say off to the next house, so only a dish or two in the morning?
A: No, she has time. Not in a rush at all.
Q: On Sunday, when the cook doesn't come, who cooks? Or is a meal eaten out?
A: Padma cooks everything on Sunday. We hardly order in, maybe once a month.
A: oh one thing, evening Kavitha comes at 7, not 6:30
Q: What did the children have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Karan had idli Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, upma Thursday, bread toast Friday, Saturday idli again.
A: Padma and I mostly had dosa with allam chutney. Amma had ragi java a couple of days.
Q: The children's lunch over the past week, or their school tiffin?
A: Karan takes tiffin to school Mon to Fri. Chapati roll, lemon rice, veg pulao, curd rice.
Q: The children's dinner over the past week?
A: Karan eats same as us at dinner. Chapati with a curry, or rice and pappu.
Q: What did the adults have for breakfast over the past week? Tell me in as much detail as you can.
A: Padma and I had dosa with allam chutney most days. Amma had ragi java a couple of days and idli once or twice.
A: Nanna had soft idli or upma, nothing chewy.
Q: The adults' lunch over the past week?
A: Same as always: rice, pappu, a curry, rasam, curd. Dondakaya, beans, bendakaya curries that week.
A: Amma and Nanna had the same, just Nanna's curry mashed softer.
Q: The adults' dinner over the past week?
A: Same as usual: chapati with a curry, or rice and pappu. Amma had jowar roti instead of chapati.
Q: Is anyone on a diet? High protein, low carb, diabetic, anything a doctor asked for.
A: Amma is diabetic, no sugar at all. Ragi is good for her a few times a week.
A: Nanna needs less salt and soft food, trouble chewing. No other diets.
Q: Besides that diet, do the elders eat anything differently: less salt, softer food, no onion or garlic, a fasting day?
A: Told you already, Nanna needs less salt and soft food. Amma fasts on Ekadashi, twice a month, only fruits that day.
A: No onion or garlic restrictions, they eat everything else we do.
Q: Any food rules for the house? Veg, egg or non-veg days, fasting days, allergies, a dish someone won't touch.
A: Amma and Nanna are pure vegetarian, no eggs or meat. The three of us eat chicken only on Sunday lunch.
A: No allergies. Amma fasts Ekadashi twice a month, only fruits.
Q: How often do you order in, and on which days?
A: Hardly order in, maybe once a month. No fixed day.
Q: Does anything come on a subscription, like Country Delight or a milkman?
A: Milk from Heritage, delivered daily.
